title: Give CI the no-fail-fast the local suite already learned
action: Both CI jobs stop at the first red test TARGET, so later targets go unrun while the summary reads like a full pass - the exact hole that hid a red registry_dispatch locally. Add --no-fail-fast to the cargo test invocation in .github/workflows/ci.yml (:102, inside the set -o pipefail block - keep the pipefail and the tee) and .github/workflows/windows.yml (:64). Touch nothing else in either workflow. The third copy, commands.test in .bee/config.json, is already patched on main - verify it carries --no-fail-fast and say so in the cap rather than re-editing.

truths: Both workflow cargo test invocations carry --no-fail-fast
set -o pipefail and the tee capture in ci.yml are untouched
Nothing else in either workflow changes - the diff is two lines
commands.test in .bee/config.json verified to already carry --no-fail-fast
